title: Oxide derivatives of metal–organic frameworks for water splitting: a concise review
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,921-941
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01525H, Review Article
Murugesan Abitha, Chinnusamy Viswanathan, Nagamony Ponpandian
This article discusses water splitting principles, strategies like electronegative atom incorporation, heterostructures, hybrids, bimetallic centers, and rapid mass transport, concluding with insights on MOF-derived oxides and future directions.
